description: Answers: where is a company incorporated and headquartered, and which companies are tied to a country? From each company's own SEC record: state or country of incorporation, business and mailing address, and whether it files as a foreign private issuer (20-F, 40-F, 6-K). Arguments (all optional): company (name, ticker or CIK) for one company; country (e.g. Cayman Islands, Ireland, China) for every company incorporated or headquartered there; crosses_border true for companies incorporated in one country and run from another. Without arguments: counts by country. A place of incorporation is a legal fact, never a finding of wrongdoing.
name: get_country_record
title: Where companies are based
